records.context: Build the graph for ``project`` through the job runner and draw it when ready.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.pipeline_graph.PipelineGraphScreen.load_project#0
records.source: Build the graph for ``project`` through the job runner and draw it when ready.
records.translation: Bygg grafen för ``project`` via jobbhanteraren och rita den när den är klar.

records.context: In executed in a worker mode, returns once the job is submitted; an unthreaded screen builds the graph and delivers its result inline before returning. :attr:`graph_loaded` fires when the graph is drawn. A project with no registry is not a failure — it draws the declared module order and says nothing has run.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.pipeline_graph.PipelineGraphScreen.load_project#1
records.source: In threaded mode, returns once the job is submitted; an unthreaded screen builds the graph and delivers its result inline before returning. :attr:`graph_loaded` fires when the graph is drawn. A project with no registry is not a failure — it draws the declared module order and says nothing has run.
records.translation: I trådat läge återgår anropet när jobbet har skickats in; en skärm utan trådning bygger grafen och levererar resultatet direkt i samma anrop innan det återgår. :attr:`graph_loaded` skickas när grafen ritas. Ett projekt utan register är inget fel — det visar den deklarerade modulordningen och anger att inget har körts.

records.context: CSV file with ``feature`` and ``coefficient`` columns; read and rebuilt with the chosen link on a background execution unit by default, or inline when the screen is unthreaded. An empty path only asks for a table.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.profiler.ProfilerScreen.load_coefficients#1
records.source: CSV file with ``feature`` and ``coefficient`` columns; read and rebuilt with the chosen link on a worker thread by default, or inline when the screen is unthreaded. An empty path only asks for a table.
records.translation: CSV-fil med kolumnerna ``feature`` och ``coefficient``; läses och byggs om med den valda länken på en arbetstråd som standard, eller direkt i samma anrop när skärmen inte är trådad. En tom sökväg ber bara om en tabell.

records.context: Re-read the verdicts through the job runner.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.qc_dashboard.QCDashboardScreen.refresh#0
records.source: Re-read the verdicts through the job runner.
records.translation: Läs in bedömningarna på nytt via jobbhanteraren.

records.context: By default, the parse and the two decisions in front of it -- "is this a folder?" and "has anything changed?" -- all run on the worker, because both decisions touch the disk at a path the user typed. `os.path.isdir` is one call, and `_fingerprint` is a `find_scorecards` listing plus a stat per artifact. An unthreaded screen performs the same work inline.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.qc_dashboard.QCDashboardScreen.refresh#1
records.source: By default, the parse and the two decisions in front of it -- "is this a folder?" and "has anything changed?" -- all run on the worker, because both decisions touch the disk at a path the user typed. `os.path.isdir` is one call, and `_fingerprint` is a `find_scorecards` listing plus a stat per artifact. An unthreaded screen performs the same work inline.
records.translation: Som standard körs både parsningen och de två föregående besluten -- "är detta en mapp?" och "har något ändrats?" -- på arbetstråden, eftersom båda besluten läser från disken vid en sökväg som användaren skrivit in. `os.path.isdir` är ett anrop, och `_fingerprint` är en listning med `find_scorecards` samt ett stat-anrop per artefakt. En skärm utan trådning gör samma arbete direkt i samma anrop.

records.context: Measured on one workstation: a single `os.path.exists` under `/nas_mnt`, an `autofs` mount whose share was asleep, had not returned after twenty seconds -- the stat is what triggers the automount. Execute on the main GUI execution path, that call would freeze the whole interface, with no traceback, whenever such a folder was dropped, browsed to or refreshed.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.qc_dashboard.QCDashboardScreen.refresh#2
records.source: Measured on one workstation: a single `os.path.exists` under `/nas_mnt`, an `autofs` mount whose share was asleep, had not returned after twenty seconds -- the stat is what triggers the automount. Run on the GUI thread, that call would freeze the whole interface, with no traceback, whenever such a folder was dropped, browsed to or refreshed.
records.translation: Uppmätt på en arbetsstation: ett enda `os.path.exists` under `/nas_mnt`, en `autofs`-montering vars nätverksresurs vilade, hade inte returnerat efter tjugo sekunder -- det är stat-anropet som utlöser automatisk montering. På GUI-tråden skulle detta anrop frysa hela gränssnittet utan stackspårning varje gång en sådan mapp släpptes in, valdes i en filväljare eller uppdaterades.

records.context: `path_probe` is not used for the folder guard. It answers optimistically, so it could only ever say "go on and read", which the worker then checks anyway; a second guard on the main GUI execution path would only allow the two answers to disagree. The application view's messages are unchanged; they appear when the worker finishes.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.qc_dashboard.QCDashboardScreen.refresh#3
records.source: `path_probe` is not used for the folder guard. It answers optimistically, so it could only ever say "go on and read", which the worker then checks anyway; a second guard on the GUI thread would only allow the two answers to disagree. The screen's messages are unchanged; they appear when the worker finishes.
records.translation: `path_probe` används inte för kontrollen av mappen. Den svarar optimistiskt och kan därför bara säga "go on and read" (fortsätt och läs), vilket arbetstråden ändå kontrollerar. En andra kontroll på GUI-tråden skulle bara göra det möjligt för de två svaren att motsäga varandra. Skärmens meddelanden är oförändrade; de visas när arbetstråden är klar.

records.context: whether a read of the disk was started. Reading inline (``threaded=False``) that is exact, because the worker half has already run and reported by the time this returns. With worker execution, it means the job was started: the fingerprint is not taken yet, so "nothing changed" arrives later, on the status line.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.qc_dashboard.QCDashboardScreen.refresh#5
records.source: whether a read of the disk was started. Reading inline (``threaded=False``) that is exact, because the worker half has already run and reported by the time this returns. Threaded, it means the job was started: the fingerprint is not taken yet, so "nothing changed" arrives later, on the status line.
records.translation: om en läsning från disk startades. Vid läsning direkt i anropet (``threaded=False``) är det svaret exakt, eftersom arbetardelen redan har körts och rapporterat när funktionen returnerar. Vid trådad körning betyder det att jobbet startades: fingeravtrycket har ännu inte beräknats, så "nothing changed" (inget ändrades) visas senare på statusraden.

records.context: Re-collects rather than reusing the scan, so the file reflects the folder as it is now and the figure cap as it is now.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.report.ReportScreen.generate#1
records.source: Re-collects rather than reusing the scan, so the file reflects the folder as it is now and the figure cap as it is now.
records.translation: Samlar in på nytt i stället för att återanvända skanningen, så att filen återspeglar mappens aktuella innehåll och den aktuella gränsen för antalet figurer.

records.context: True when the job was started; unthreaded, True only when the report callable and its completion handler return without throwing.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.report.ReportScreen.generate#2
records.source: True when the job was started; unthreaded, True only when the report callable and its completion handler return without raising.
records.translation: True när jobbet har startats; utan trådning är värdet True endast när rapportfunktionen och dess slutförandehanterare återgår utan att kasta undantag.

records.context: Reload processing-session records on a background execution unit by default, or inline when constructed with ``threaded=False``.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.run_history.RunHistoryScreen.refresh#0
records.source: Reload run records on a worker thread by default, or inline when constructed with ``threaded=False``.
records.translation: Läs in körningsposterna på en arbetstråd som standard, eller direkt i samma anrop när skärmen har skapats med ``threaded=False``.
